meta.title: Web Application Projects Kerala & UAE | Teknoppy Portfolio
meta.description: Custom web applications, portals and dashboards built by Teknoppy for businesses whose workflow did not fit off-the-shelf software.

body.html: Booking systems, customer portals and dashboards Teknoppy has built for businesses running processes that off-the-shelf software could not handle. Each was shaped around a workflow the client already had, rather than asking their team to adopt a new one — which is usually the reason the off-the-shelf tool failed in the first place.

sections.intro: The services these builds draw on, each with its own page.

items.title: Web Application Development
items.text: Custom applications built around an existing business process — portals, booking systems and internal tools.

items.title: Dashboard UI Design
items.text: Interfaces for data-heavy screens, where the job is making a dense view readable rather than decorating it.

items.title: Web App UI Design
items.text: Interface and interaction design for application screens, done before development starts.

items.title: Marketplace Development
items.text: Multi-vendor platforms with seller onboarding, listings management and split payments.

paragraphs.html: Both projects above began with a UX audit of how the work was being done before any screens were designed. Interface design came next, and development only after the flow was agreed — the order matters most on applications, where a wrong assumption is expensive to unpick later.
Adoption and performance figures for these applications are documented on Case Studies. For the wider portfolio, see all project categories.

items.q: What counts as a web application rather than a website?
items.a: A website presents information; an application does work. The projects above handle live requests, user accounts and operational data rather than published pages.

items.q: Will you work around our existing process?
items.a: Yes. Both applications above were built around a workflow the client already ran, which is why they were commissioned instead of an off-the-shelf tool.

items.q: Do you design the interface as well as build it?
items.a: Yes. Interface and dashboard design are done in-house before development begins.
